The Ground Truth Answer states the age difference as "6 months and 26 days." The Predicted Answer provides both the birthdates (which allows independent verification) and states the difference as "about 7 months" or 209 days. Converting 6 months and 26 days to days (typically around 30 days per month for this calculation) gives us approximately 206 days, which aligns very closely with 209 days. Both answers are essentially conveying the same information—the difference is within a few days, and the "about 7 months" phrasing matches "6 months and 26 days" for all practical purposes.
